rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: USHAMART: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 and in continuation of the disclosure made by the Company on 14th October 2025, we hereby inform that, upon the Company''s request for re-evaluation, EcoVadis has revised the Company''s (Ranchi Site) sustainability score from 63 to 67 (on a scale of 100). The Company continues to retain the "Bronze Medal" recognition awarded by EcoVadis, reflecting sustained performance across environmental, social and governance (ESG) parameters.
